title: Talk it through 4.2
role: Mediator using persuasive language to negotiate for peace through tourism
can_do: I can use persuasive language to defend tourism as a culture for peace.
I can negotiate, propose compromises and respond to objections.

nodes.partner_line: Why should we invest in tourism after the conflict?
nodes.translation: ¿Por qué deberíamos invertir en turismo después del conflicto?

options.text: Because visitors bring jobs, and jobs bring stability.
I firmly believe that shared travel builds trust between communities.
Consider this: where people meet, understanding grows.

nodes.partner_line: But many people still do not trust each other.
nodes.translation: Pero mucha gente todavía no confía en los demás.
nodes.model_reply: That is why we must build trust through dialogue.

nodes.partner_line: What do you propose as a first step?

options.text: I propose a joint route run by both communities.
Let us start with a small shared festival.
We could begin with exchange visits for young guides.

nodes.partner_line: That would cost us a lot. Could we find a compromise?
nodes.translation: Eso nos costaría mucho. ¿Podríamos encontrar un compromiso?

options.text: Certainly. What if the costs were shared equally?
I am open to that. Perhaps each side could contribute in kind.
Let us look for common ground. Which part worries you most?

nodes.partner_line: We are worried about losing control of our own heritage.
nodes.translation: Nos preocupa perder el control de nuestro propio patrimonio.

options.text: That is a fair concern. The agreement could guarantee your ownership.
I understand. You would keep the final say on cultural content.
No one is asking you to give anything up; we want to share, not take.

nodes.partner_line: Very well. We will consider your proposal seriously.
nodes.translation: Muy bien. Consideraremos su propuesta con seriedad.

options.text: Thank you. I believe we can build something lasting together.
I appreciate your openness. We will await your answer.
That is encouraging. Let us meet again next month.
